ticket.summary: Reprint a shipping label from the shipment page
ticket.description:
As a seller I can reprint the label of a shipment that was already created, without creating a new shipment.

Rules:
- The Reprint label button is shown for shipments that are not voided and not delivered.
- Reprinting uses the same tracking number and does not create a new charge.
- The label format (PDF or ZPL) follows the account's carrier configuration.
- Only users with the Shipments permission can reprint.
- If the courier cannot return the label, an error message is shown and the seller can try again.
ticket.acceptanceCriteria:
1. Reprint is available for active shipments and returns the same tracking number.
2. No new charge is created.
3. A user without the Shipments permission does not see the button.
4. A courier error shows a retry option.

reference.title: Reprint the label of an active shipment
reference.expected: The same tracking number is used and no new charge is created

reference.title: Reprint is hidden for a voided shipment
Courier cannot return the label
reference.expected: An error is shown with a retry option
